name: strata-protocol
description: Single source of truth for Strata JSON-RPC 2.0 constants, methods, events, error codes, and wire DTOs.

protocol.doc: Core Strata module, plugin, and configuration defaults.

DEFAULT_SSH_KEEPALIVE_SECS.doc: Default Dropbear keepalive interval in seconds.

DEFAULT_LOG_MAX_BYTES.doc: Maximum log file size before rotation (256 KiB).

DEFAULT_EXTRA_CHAR_DEV.doc: Default character device exposed to primary container.

DEFAULT_WEB_PORT.doc: Default embedded Web/PC console HTTP+WS port.

DEFAULT_WEB_LISTEN_LOCAL.doc: Default loopback-only Web console bind address.

DEFAULT_WEB_LISTEN_LAN.doc: LAN-mode Web console bind address (restricted to RFC1918 peers).

DEFAULT_DISTRO_MIRROR_TUNA.doc: Primary China-accessible Simplestreams ARM64 rootfs mirror.

paths.doc: Canonical Android host and in-container runtime paths.

l5DiagPaths.doc: Canonical read-only L5 kernel diagnostic bind mount paths.

errorCodes.doc: Standard JSON-RPC 2.0 and Strata domain error codes.

ServiceRestartPolicy.doc: Automatic restart policy for a managed container background service.

variants.name: OnFailure
variants.doc: Restart only on non-zero exit or signal.

ServiceStatus.doc: Runtime lifecycle status of a managed container background service.

DistroMirror.doc: Online Simplestreams ARM64 distro catalog mirror selection.

ContainerJobKind.doc: Kind of asynchronous container provisioning or storage job.

ContainerJobState.doc: Execution state of an asynchronous container provisioning job.

CapProfile.doc: Container Linux capability policy derived from configuration or debug override.

variants.name: Isolated
variants.doc: Standard container without Android PID 1 nsenter bridge privileges.

variants.name: HostBridge
variants.doc: Developer container with host-exec and debug bridge privileges.

variants.name: FullHostRuntime
variants.doc: Full privileged runtime mode (debug or hostRuntime=true).

ContainerPhase.doc: Observable lifecycle phase for a managed container.

SessionMode.doc: Execution mode for an interactive CLI attach lease.

variants.name: Attached
variants.doc: Join an already-running container namespaces via setns.

variants.name: Oneshot
variants.doc: Temporarily mount a stopped container for a foreground session.

variants.name: Debug
variants.doc: Temporarily mount a stopped container with full host /dev, /sys, /proc.

TaskStream.doc: Output stream label for task.output events.

WebConsoleConfig.doc: Embedded HTTP/WebSocket PC Console control-plane settings.

SideVeilBridgeConfig.doc: Optional SideVeil uds-native plugin bridge configuration.

SshConfig.doc: Dropbear SSH listener settings for a container.

ContainerServiceSpec.doc: Declarative configuration for a supervised background service inside a container.

ContainerConfig.doc: Per-container runtime, storage, isolation, and networking specification.

AttachLease.doc: Lease granted by stratad to strata CLI for local setns or stage2 sessions.

ContainerDiskStats.doc: Disk allocation and rootfs utilization snapshot.

ContainerStatusSnapshot.doc: Complete status snapshot for one container.

DaemonSummarySnapshot.doc: Compact daemon summary for daemon.status and Native HUD.

StorageCleanupReport.doc: Verification counters returned after stopping or tearing down a container.

MaintenanceDonePayload.doc: Asynchronous completion event for long-running maintenance operations.

ContainerSelectorParams.doc: Shared selector parameter targeting an explicit or default container.

TaskSummary.doc: Summary descriptor returned by task.list and task.logs.

TaskOutputPayload.doc: Payload pushed with task.output events and returned by task.logs.

HudStateResult.doc: Result returned by hud.state and hud.set.

KernelCapabilitiesResult.doc: Live kernel container capability probe returned by daemon.capabilities.

WebStatusResult.doc: Runtime status of the embedded HTTP/WebSocket PC Console server.

DistroEntry.doc: Single ARM64 rootfs image entry from a Simplestreams catalog.

ContainerJobStartResult.doc: Result returned immediately when an async container provisioning job is accepted.

ContainerJobProgressPayload.doc: Progress snapshot emitted with container.job.progress and returned by container.jobStatus.

ContainerServiceRuntime.doc: Live runtime status for a supervised background service inside a container.

ServiceSelectorParams.doc: Parameters selecting one supervised service inside a container.

ServiceStateChangedPayload.doc: Event payload emitted on service.stateChanged transitions.

outputs.header: biome-ignore-all lint/suspicious/noConfusingVoidType: generated RPC map uses void for parameterless methods
